scope:
Joint binary realization of a fixed Gram from a complete finite cover.

Necessary constraints beyond separate signatures: exact H^t H=7R, B H=0,
all row-to-rectangle counts H=T P, and all two-vertex conditional PSD tests.
Optional C2 layers remain relaxations unless the entire C2 system is used.
Each fixed Gram is a branch, never a stand-alone exclusion of its template.

four_corner_tables.test: Exact four-corner conditional PSD and four-signature sums.

local_component_tables.scope: Every true connected line component is covered; no local witness is fixed.

six_prism_profiles.scope:
One-hot boundary profiles when a root line has six prism components.

There are 60 outside vertices and six components of six neighbours of
the line. Every outside vertex chooses one neighbour in each component,
two in each of the three colours. Its two colour-zero neighbours are
its fixed label. Hence exactly 96 possible remaining four-symbol rows.
The 240 common-neighbour equations on pairs of nonzero-colour vertices
in different prisms become linear sums of profile indicators.
